kind: Direct Wasm AIR to layered arithmetic compiler semantics
formal_claims: Every successful compilation preserves the actual current-row AIR field evaluation.
Compilation succeeds exactly for constants/current cells/add/mul/neg; selectors, public inputs and next-row accesses reject.
Every gate relation has degree at most two in its immediate wire values.
Vanishing compiled i32.add range constraints is equivalent to the actual source AIR and implies actual Wasm Num.binop behavior.
Every UInt32 operand pair has an honest compiled witness.
limitations: Lean lowering is a depth-indexed tree with copy padding, no shared-wire optimization.
Rust uses an independently tested quadratic lowering; formal refinement between the implementations remains.
No fresh GKR/WHIR proof, recursion, full NEAR transition or 1 Pgas benchmark.
